chunks: My father (may Allah have mercy on him) said: Ahmad ibn Idris said: Muhammad ibn Ahmad said, on the authority of Yusuf ibn al-Harith, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Arzami, on the authority of his father Abd al-Rahman, who elevated the chain to the one who said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) say:
Allah decreed the destinies fifty thousand years before He created the heavens and the earth.
ai.seo_question: When did Allah decree the destinies according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Tawhid establishes the pre-eternal nature of divine decree, citing a period of fifty thousand years before creation, which Shia scholars utilize to reconcile divine omniscience with human free will. It underscores the concept of 'al-Maqadir' (the specific measures and destinies) being inscribed in the Preserved Tablet, affirming that while outcomes are known and decreed by Allah, the mechanism of choice remains intact for creation.

en.sayed-ali-raza-rizvi: 7. My father (RA) said: Ahmad ibn Idris said: Muhammad ibn Ahmad said, on the authority of Yusuf ibn al-Harith, on the authority of Muhammad ibn `Abd al-Rahman al-`Arzami, on the authority of his father `Abd al-Rahman who eliminated the chain of transmission to the person who said I heard the Messenger of Allah (SA) say: “
Allah decreed the destinies fifty thousand years before He created the heavens and the earth.”
